tooltip.shadowbound.blade.pylon: Right click to raise a Soul Pylon and burn them.
enchantment.shadowbound.soul_pylon.desc: Right click a Shadow blade holding shadows to raise a pylon for 10 seconds that gives you Regeneration and burns them for healing and absorption.
tooltip.shadowbound.grimoire: Use to set it down. Use it again to draw a rite in the air. Hit it to pick it back up.
tooltip.shadowbound.paper: Something is drawn on it in dried ink.
paper.shadowbound.cleaver: An axe of the deep forge, an ingot torn from ancient debris, and a weight of gold. Carry them, wait for the sun to die, and draw its three marks in the air above the grimoire, in order.
paper.shadowbound.longsword: A blade of the deep forge, one more ingot of it, and a block of diamond. Carry them, wait for the sun to die, and draw its three marks in the air above the grimoire, in order.
paper.shadowbound.totem: A charm that cheats death, two blocks of diamond, and ten rods taken from blazes. Carry them, wait for the sun to die, and draw its three marks in the air above the grimoire, in order.
paper.shadowbound.soul_pylon: A plain book, four echoes of the deep dark, and a lantern that burns souls. Carry them, wait for the sun to die, and draw its three marks in the air above the grimoire, in order.
message.shadowbound.cast.unknown: The shadows don't know that shape.
message.shadowbound.cast.day: The shadows won't answer while the sun is up.
message.shadowbound.cast.busy: A rite is already burning here.
message.shadowbound.cast.offerings: You aren't carrying what this rite asks for.
tooltip.shadowbound.totem.0: Your shadow walks with you while you hold this.
tooltip.shadowbound.totem.2: Saves you from death. Your shadow dies instead.
tooltip.shadowbound.totem.3: [G] sink into the shadows  [H] put out the lights  [V] watch
message.shadowbound.snuff.no_darkness: Not enough darkness to put the lights out.
message.shadowbound.dive.too_bright: Too bright to sink in here.
message.shadowbound.dive.drained: The darkness runs dry. You surface.
screen.shadowbound.spy.title: Watch from the Dark
screen.shadowbound.spy.subtitle: pick someone. they won't see you.
screen.shadowbound.spy.ready: Click a name to start watching
screen.shadowbound.spy.too_bright: Not dark enough yet. Charge the meter.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.0: %s builds like the blueprint was a dare.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.1: Hey %s, nice armor. Did it come with the starter kit?
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.2: %s has been mining for an hour and still has stone tools. Respect, honestly.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.3: I've seen creepers with better spatial awareness than %s.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.4: %s walks into lava the way other people walk into rooms. Confidently.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.5: Don't mind %s, they're just here to lower the server average.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.6: %s, your base has the vibe of a dirt hut that got promoted.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.7: I followed %s home once. Wish I hadn't. That interior design.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.8: %s's sword has never touched blood. Only grass.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.9: Fun fact: %s is the reason villagers raise their prices.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.10: %s fights like they're holding the controller upside down.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.11: If %s were a block they'd be gravel. Falls over, gets in the way.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.12: %s, the endermen are looking at you. Not because you looked at them. Out of pity.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.13: Watch %s try to place a torch. Watch closely. Second attempt incoming.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.14: %s has a farm. Of what? Unclear. Neither do the crops.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.15: %s smells like a zombie that gave up.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.16: I'm a literal shadow and I still have more personality than %s.
chat.shadowbound.clone.player.17: %s, I'd say watch your back, but I'm the one who does that and I'm busy.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.0: Nobody else around? Fine. %s, your hair's weird today.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.1: %s, I'm the best thing that's ever happened to you and you know it.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.2: Bored. %s, go hit something so I can hit it harder.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.3: Every time you turn the lights on I get a little weaker, %s. Think about that.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.4: %1$s walks, I walk. %1$s jumps, I jump. Truly the most thrilling job in the world.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.5: Do you ever think about how I'm the cool version of you, %s?
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.6: It's so quiet. I love it. Don't ruin it, %s.
chat.shadowbound.clone.owner.7: Psst. %s. Behind you. ...It's me. It's always me.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.0: Look at that %s. Living its little life. Disgusting.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.1: That %s has been staring at me for a while. Rude.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.2: I could take that %s. I could take two of that %s.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.3: Somebody tell that %s it's not the main character.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.4: That %s has the brain of a dropped item.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.5: Hey %s, you're standing in my light. Wait, no. Keep doing that.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.7: One day I'll be the shadow of a %s. Can't wait to be downgraded.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.8: Bet that %s can't even see in the dark. Amateur.
chat.shadowbound.clone.mob.9: Every %s I've ever met has been a disappointment, and this one's no different.
chat.shadowbound.clone.spawn.1: Back again. Try to keep up this time.
chat.shadowbound.clone.spawn.2: Ugh. Daylight's for amateurs. Let's go.
chat.shadowbound.clone.spawn.3: %1$s holds the totem, %1$s gets the better half. You're welcome.
chat.shadowbound.clone.kill.1: That %s won't be needing its shadow anymore.
chat.shadowbound.clone.kill.3: Did everyone see that? I want everyone to have seen that %s go down.
chat.shadowbound.clone.hurt.0: Hey! I'm made of feelings! Dark ones!
chat.shadowbound.clone.hurt.1: %s, are you going to help or just watch?
chat.shadowbound.clone.hurt.2: That one's going in my diary.
chat.shadowbound.clone.hurt.4: Five hearts, people. FIVE. Be gentle.
chat.shadowbound.clone.death.0: Tell the dark I said hi...
chat.shadowbound.clone.death.2: I'll be back. Shadows always come back.
chat.shadowbound.clone.death.3: Avenge me, %s. Or don't. You won't.
chat.shadowbound.clone.sacrifice.0: Fine. Take it. You owe me, %s.
message.shadowbound.cast.how: Draw a rite's three marks, one at a time. Hold right click and sweep across the nodes, let go to burn a mark in. Left click or sneak to stop.
paper.shadowbound.step.0: This is the first mark. Begin where the ink pooled.
paper.shadowbound.step.1: This is the second mark. Begin where the ink pooled.
paper.shadowbound.step.2: This is the last mark. Begin where the ink pooled.
message.shadowbound.cast.broken: The mark doesn't belong. The circle burns out.
